<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class OrderApiMapper
{
    public static function toOrder(OrderApi $source): Order
    {
        $target = new Order();
        $target->id = $source->getId() ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.');
        $target->customerId = $source->getCustomer()->getId() ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.');
        $target->customerName = $source->getCustomer()->getName();
        $target->shippingAddress = self::toAddress($source->getShipping());
        $target->status = $source->getStatus();
        return $target;
    }

    public static function toAddress(AddressApi $source): Address
    {
        $target = new Address();
        $target->street = $source->getStreet();
        $target->city = $source->getCity();
        $target->postalCode = $source->getZipCode();
        $target->country = $source->getCountry();
        return $target;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class OrderApiMapper
{
    public static function toOrder(array $source): Order
    {
        $target = new Order();
        $target->id = $source['id'] ?? null ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.');
        $target->customerId = $source['customer']['id'] ?? null ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.');
        $target->customerName = $source['customer']['name'];
        $target->shippingAddress = self::toAddress($source['shipping']);
        $target->status = $source['status'];
        return $target;
    }

    public static function toAddress(array $source): Address
    {
        $target = new Address();
        $target->street = $source['street'];
        $target->city = $source['city'];
        $target->postalCode = $source['zipCode'];
        $target->country = $source['country'];
        return $target;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class OrderApiMapper
{
    public static function toOrder(OrderApi $source): array
    {
        return [
            'Id' => $source->getId() ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
            'CustomerId' => $source->getCustomer()->getId() ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
            'CustomerName' => $source->getCustomer()->getName(),
            'ShippingAddress' => self::toAddress($source->getShipping()),
            'Status' => $source->getStatus(),
        ];
    }

    public static function toAddress(AddressApi $source): array
    {
        return [
            'Street' => $source->getStreet(),
            'City' => $source->getCity(),
            'PostalCode' => $source->getZipCode(),
            'Country' => $source->getCountry(),
        ];
    }
}
